headline: Chest-high SSE, clean only for the morning window.
today: Decent SSE swell to 2.6ft at a good angle, with offshore N wind through the morning before S cross-on and onshore ruin it by afternoon. Get it early on the push to the 9:14a high — fish or shortboard. Ditch has the same swell better organized and a shorter drive, so only make this haul if Rhode Island's your thing.

daysToWatch.note: Short-period S junk with cross-off NE wind at 14mph — groomed but weak and wrong-angle. Not worth it.
